description: Sets an alert on agentPickup's marketplace for something the person wants that isn't listed yet (or that they want more of): words, a category, a top price, and a place and distance. When a matching item is listed, they get an email. Up to 10 alerts; my_alerts lists or stops them. Needs sign-in.

currency.description: The top price's currency as an ISO code, if it isn't the local one.

max_price.description: Their top price, in the local currency where they're watching (or in currency).

max_price_aud.description: Older name for max_price, in Australian dollars. Use max_price.

near.description: A suburb with its city, state or country, e.g. "New Farm QLD" or "Shoreditch, London".

within_km.description: How far they'll travel, in km. Default 10.

name: create_alert
title: Watch for an item
